custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location only.
  • Start at location B on the Inventory page (pick location B in the location selector, then Parts, then Inventory).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425617-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425617-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Inventory Part" window opens at location B.

Step 2:

  • Description shows part A's description.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows the number with the spaces.

Step 4:

  • Category shows the category you picked.

Step 5:

  • Cost shows 10.00.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the part is saved, with no message about the Part Library, because the descriptions match.

Step 7:

  • At location B, part A is listed with no spaces before or after its number.

Step 8:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 9:

  • Exactly one entry is listed for part A: no second entry with spaces was made.

Step 10:

  • Its detail page shows "Total parts" 2, with Workplace rows for the test location and location B: the new part was linked to the existing entry.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S11-R6a: “Every route in S11-R6 removes spaces before and after the part number before it looks for an exact match.”
  • S7-R3: “Spaces before and after the part number and the description are removed on save.”
  • S7-R4: “On save, the system looks for a Part Library entry whose number is exactly the number typed, including upper and lower case.”
  • S7-R5: “If exactly one entry matches, the new part is linked to that entry.”
  • S7-R10: “No message about the Part Library is shown when the descriptions match, or when a new entry is created.”
